description: HTTP/2 request smuggling via Python h2 library with header validation disabled. Allows CRLF in header values and appending smuggled HTTP/1.1 requests in the body. Returns all responses received.

headers.description: Array of [name, value] pairs — CRLF allowed in values for smuggling

smuggled_request.description: Optional complete HTTP/1.1 request to append after body for CL.0 / H2.CL smuggling

name: raw_h2_smuggle
